name: Grant Writing Program Survey

about: The grant writing program includes reviewer analysis, help preparing proposal materials, and grantsmanship training.
This survey asks whether it is helping you write and submit grants.

opt_out.question: optout
opt_out.short: Didn’t use the grant writing program

questions.prompt: I haven’t used the grant writing program since the last reporting period.

sections.title: Survey questions
sections.instructions: Please indicate how much you agree with each statement about the grant writing program. The program includes reviewer analysis, help preparing proposal materials, and grantsmanship training.

questions.prompt: Provides helpful feedback on my proposal documents when requested.
Has given me tools to improve my grant writing skills.
Has made the process of submitting grant proposals easier.
What are things that are functioning well regarding the grant writing program?
What are things that could be improved regarding the grant writing program?

_source: Team_Science.pdf (Piestar export), split into four surveys (MW, 2026-10-24); open-ended prompts reworded per topic.
